facts.fact: The OGP page for commitment KE0034 (Kenya Action Plan 2023-2027) says the KODI portal has been offline for some years for lack of a legal framework, and that no legal mandate requires publishing budget data; it lists an open data guidebook (2025) as a planned milestone only.
facts.system: Kenya Open Data Initiative legal framework
